title: DataToolRunDocument
description: Server-only record of one applied run of a backfill or migration tool under tool/data/ (FIX-7), at dataToolRuns/{runId}: which tool, at which commit, against which project, what it counted and when. Written by the tool itself through tool/data/lib/run_record.mjs with the Admin SDK; dry runs write nothing. It holds counts and a migration or scope name, never document data or personal data. Deleted 365 days after the run starts.

runId.description: The document id: the tool's file name, the start time in milliseconds and eight random hex digits.

tool.description: The tool's path in the repository.

scope.description: What the run covered, such as the migration names; null when the tool has no selector.

projectId.description: The Firebase project the run wrote to.

commitSha.description: The commit the tool ran from; null when Git was unavailable.

commitDirty.description: Whether tracked files differed from that commit; null when Git was unavailable.

status.description: running until the apply phase ends; a run that dies midway stays running.

counts.description: What the run counted, such as documents created per migration; on failure, the counts reached so far.

failure.description: The error's name and first message line when the run failed.

expiresAt.description: 365 days after the run starts; the collection's TTL policy deletes it then.
